edge_cases: K is stored [S,D] row-major (row j IS key vector j) -- scores = Q . K^T needs no explicit transpose, only swapped tile indices in the crouton weight pack
2x2 grid of 32x32 output tiles; each accumulates over 2 D-tiles
HMX accumulator persists across D-tile matmuls (one mxclracc per out tile)
activation int8 in high byte of crouton slot (low bytes dead)
weight 4-deep packed; different load limit than activation
input range chosen so |requant| < 2048 (12-bit field exact, no saturation)
crouton pack/unpack staged via cacheable buffers + bulk vector copy
missing-transpose near-miss (computes Q.K, not Q.K^T) must fail
